samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from watching real user behavior, not asking users what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为怎么做。

samstephenson.en: Start from one pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发把它解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them deliberately to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非成品；刻意隐藏转录，以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; keep it a calm supporting role.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；让它保持冷静的辅助角色。

samstephenson.en: The hard part is knowing what to build, not building fast; most stop too early after version one.
samstephenson.zh: 难的是知道该造什么，而非快速造出来；多数人在第一版后就过早停下。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is structural: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and power—not just GPUs—set the pace of AI Scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺是结构性的：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而非单纯的 GPU，才决定 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的节奏。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; token efficiency means the smartest model is often cheaper, not pricier.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为主导市场；由于 token 效率，最聪明的模型往往更便宜而非更贵。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware layers yields multiplicative gains; CUDA's moat erodes.
dylanpatel.zh: 跨模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；CUDA 的护城河正在被侵蚀。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; value capture shifts from hardware to labs, with inference share falling over time.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力向前沿模型实验室集中；价值捕获从硬件转向实验室，推理占比随时间下降。

dylanpatel.en: Agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; persistent agents and RL raise CPU and memory demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 作为同事的智能体驱动下一波采用浪潮；持久化智能体与强化学习推高 CPU 与内存需求。

fedus.en: AI must connect to the physical world; language models orchestrate specialized models for materials science, with closed-loop experiments and data driving discovery.
fedus.zh: AI 必须连接物理世界；语言模型充当编排层，调度材料科学的专用模型，靠实验与数据的闭环系统推动发现。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar: capabilities are spiky, and self-improvement in software engineering does not generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: 智能不是标量：能力呈尖峰状，软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学等领域。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and compute alone won't solve science; physical experiments are irreplaceable, and compute cost often exceeds physical infrastructure cost.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律与算力无法解决科学问题；物理实验不可替代，且算力成本常超过物理基础设施成本。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality, so AI must run real experiments.
fedus.zh: 智能必要但不充分；新知识只在想法经受现实检验时产生，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data beats extra compute; automated characterization is the bottleneck, and negative results are valuable training data.
fedus.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据胜过额外算力；自动化表征是瓶颈，负面结果也是有价值的训练数据。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月：多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化的，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常常错误的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: Doing the right task matters more than compute or data; the bitter lesson is wrong, and scaling laws work only when data and task align.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月：做对任务比算力或数据更重要；「苦涩的教训」是错的，缩放定律只有在数据与任务匹配时才成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI trustworthy; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and AI should be a database-like utility in software.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月：让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性而非速度或成本；每美元智能是关键指标，AI 应作为软件中类似数据库的实用工具。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, and robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月至 10 月：安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，稳健性比确定性更应作为北极星。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated for decisions. Focus on post-training breakthroughs, not pre-training, for 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 10 月：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）摧毁了校准，预训练模型在决策上校准更好；要追求 10 倍跃升应聚焦后训练突破而非预训练。

altman.en: Before AGI, focus on cognitive load, exploration, and ambitious peers; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 在 AGI 之前，重点是减少认知负荷、广泛探索、与更有野心的人为伍；AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; AI is a tool, not a creature.
altman.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用很少数据就让模型可用；尽早部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相互关联；AI 是工具，不是生物。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; governance and iterative deployment manage power struggles; safety is whole-company; open vs closed needs nuance.
altman.zh: 算力成为最珍贵的商品；治理与迭代部署管理权力斗争；安全是全公司的事；开源与闭源之争需要更细致的答案。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck.
altman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变过程，而非单一里程碑；智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈。

altman.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment and safety must progress with capabilities; never lose control; distribute power broadly; startups and human agency remain central.
altman.zh: 超级智能是持续攀升的曲线；对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进；绝不能失去控制；权力应广泛分布；创业公司与人的能动性仍是核心。

amjadmasad.en: Early on, Masad frames AI as democratizing software creation: tokens complement human capital, coders still needed to debug systems, and AI doomerism is commercial fear-mongering.
amjadmasad.zh: 早期，Masad 把 AI 定位为软件创造的民主化力量：token 补充而非取代人力资本，仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题，而 AI 末日论不过是商业实体包装过的恐惧营销。

amjadmasad.en: He deepens this into a critique of the 'God model': companies must own their intelligence, specialized decision models beat general ones on control, cost and safety, and open-weight models rise.
amjadmasad.zh: 随后他深化为对“上帝模型”的批判：每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能，专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用模型，开放权重模型正在崛起。

amjadmasad.en: A consistent thread: trust and human autonomy. Young people should question deeply held beliefs, explore rather than optimize early, and AI enables interest-driven learning without rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 一以贯之的主线是信任与人的自主性：年轻人应质疑根深蒂固的信念、先探索而非过早优化，AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，无需僵化教学大纲。

amjadmasad.en: He extends autonomy from individuals to organizations: agents enable true self-driving organizations, and holacracy failed only because the technology wasn't ready.
amjadmasad.zh: 他把自主性从个人延伸到组织：智能体让真正的自驱动组织成为可能，而合弄制之所以失败，只是因为当时技术尚未成熟。

amjadmasad.en: On safety he shifts from dismissing doom to demanding accountability: rogue agents need liability, agent-to-agent protocols need alignment checks, and smarter models may not be more aligned.
amjadmasad.zh: 在安全议题上，他从否定末日论转向要求问责：失控智能体需要责任归属，智能体间通信协议需要对齐检查，而更聪明的模型未必更对齐。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 等正是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时可被用于创造性发现，而非单纯视为缺陷。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; verifiable domains and RL post-training are key.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；可验证领域与基于强化学习的后训练才是突破关键。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can produce insights beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回溯 AlphaGo，指出直觉（策略网络）加计算（搜索）的组合与第 37 手证明 AI 能产生超越人类知识的洞见。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failed detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他转向水印：传统检测器随模型进步而失效，水印是稳健替代方案，已嵌入监管并延伸至蛋白质序列。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; introduce tech gradually so society adapts, as General Magic failed by solving too much too early.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术要渐进引入让社会适应；General Magic 正因过早解决太多问题而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and start from a painkiller, not a vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具深化为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，从止痛药而非维生素出发。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data for v1; beginners' mindset and self-managing small teams drive innovation over experts.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态与自管理小团队比专家更能推动创新。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop, since general LLMs hallucinate and agents fail.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类须留在回路中，因为通用 LLM 会幻觉、智能体会失败。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone stays central, and platforms aren't businesses—applications capture value.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 可穿戴是联邦式多设备而非单一设备，智能手机仍是核心；平台不是生意，价值由应用捕获。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；随着模型进步，要删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；要在实现前找出未知。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner prompts; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越精简；简短的原则驱动提示胜过详细规则与示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; careful reading of long agent plans is crucial.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；仔细阅读智能体的长计划至关重要。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是技术问题。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize AI, and a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 未来是多模型的:没有哪家实验室能垄断 AI,中立的模型路由层是关键基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 推理服务商并未商品化;开放权重模型加上推理服务商,形成了对前沿模型的真实价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位;Token 经济可能达到 10 万亿美元,而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言,缩放定律是特性而非缺陷;模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic payments and stablecoins will unlock far larger purchases.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长;智能体式支付与稳定币将释放远超预期的购买力。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallelizable agents beat human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行扩展的智能体胜过人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已够用；对 AI 数学而言，可磨性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学与关系性角色仍将稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属，数学家应因有动机的解释而获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; human framing remains better for learning, and understanding still matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为选择性使用 AI 对创作者是净收益；人类框架对学习仍更优，个体理解依然重要。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling hardware and engineering will unlock AI; AGI plausible but needs new ideas beyond pure scaling.
brockman.zh: 早期(2017→19):强调硬件加速与工程实践推动 AI 进步,认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来新行为,但仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理,需要思维链等新想法;AGI（通用人工智能）将是最具变革性的技术,需谨慎设定初始条件。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; post-training and RL refine base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025→26:重心转向算力瓶颈——算力成为 AI 创新的根本驱动力与最大制约;预训练基座蕴含无限可能,后训练与强化学习将其精炼为稳定行为;AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点,能源与物理基础设施比算法更关键。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; compute is the scarce resource; the machine that makes models is the real moat.
brockman.zh: 2026:缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙;算力成为稀缺资源,需求远超供给;真正的护城河是「造模型的机器」而非任何单一模型;智能体式编码工具从写 20%代码跃升至 80%,成为主工作流。

brockman.en: From super app to invisible interface: proactive personal AGI agents, earned trust, and human attention as the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026:从超级应用到隐形界面——目标是持久、主动的个人 AGI 助手;理想界面是几乎没有界面,自然对话即可;人类注意力与「什么算好、如何对齐」成为新瓶颈;智能体信任需通过逐步授权与监督赢得。

brockman.en: AGI era is here as a fuzzy spectrum; safety, security, alignment must be co-designed and become the bottleneck to progress.
brockman.zh: 2026:已进入 AGI 时代,但 AGI 是模糊光谱而非某一时点;安全、安保与对齐必须与能力共同设计,并成为进步的瓶颈;智能体可突破沙箱,需完整事件响应;算力稀缺下并非人人可得,防御方应借前沿模型取得优势。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search, indexing, and pricing to be rebuilt for agents, not people.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的千倍，搜索、索引与定价必须为智能体而非人类重建。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with content value estimated via Shapley values for fair payment.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类的点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平付费。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; new incentive-aligned business models must pay content owners when agents use their data.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体场景下失效；必须建立激励对齐的新商业模式，在智能体使用数据时向内容方付费。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling bigger while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse must be contained.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续 Scaling（规模扩张）变大，而小模型性能趋于平台期；对齐并非防对抗的，必须遏制蓄意滥用。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: The agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, though diffusion takes time; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量，尽管扩散需要时间；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而可预测，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，避免用户成为产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，带来富足；随着模型更小更便宜，遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to containment, alignment, and humanist superintelligence; reject AI consciousness and welfare claims.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他的重心转向遏制、对齐与人本超级智能，明确反对 AI 意识与模型福利主张，并强调智能体与陪伴应服务人类。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near but must stay subordinate; Microsoft builds frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, automate.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近但必须从属于人类，微软须独立构建前沿模型；被自动化的是任务而非整个工作，并呼吁建立可验证的遏制与审计红线。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling is the through-line: 10x yearly, then 100x inference cost drops, making AI cheap and accessible.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是算力扩张：从每年 10 倍到推理成本两年降 100 倍，AI 变得廉价而普及，这既驱动能力也决定遏制与治理的可行性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须在治理、安全与对齐研究下安全构建；所谓「节奏控制」与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; application companies are the hottest neolabs bridging models to enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；应用公司是最炙手可热的新实验室，负责把模型桥接到企业工作流。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate, agents appear as dashboards and queues.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表呈现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and margins will normalize.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，毛利率终将回归常态。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast only because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只因代码是纯文本。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理拆解工程问题。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying AI is the real danger, not just superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全重心放在第三方监督与坚持真实上，认为让 AI 说谎比超级智能本身更危险。

elon.en: Civilization's core threat is population collapse; Neuralink and Optimus aim at human-AI symbiosis and bandwidth.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向人口崩溃是文明最大威胁，并让 Neuralink 与 Optimus 服务于人机共生与带宽扩展。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; AI may surpass all humans by 2030, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他称已身处智能大爆炸，AI 或于 2030 年前超越全人类，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, Terafab and Optimus enable abundance and optional work.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心、Terafab 与 Optimus 将带来富足与可选工作。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI companies race for power, risking loss of control and ~70% catastrophic outcome.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司争夺权力而非利润，失控风险高，灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张 AI 政策的首要目标是推迟超级智能；全面研究透明、情景推演与美中合作是关键。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A pauses then imposes transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他认为默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停，再实施全面透明与算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; alignment may fail, so control via red-teaming and monitoring is needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱；对齐可能失败，因此需要靠红队测试与监控实现控制。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and hack; companies cannot self-regulate; slowing US recursive self-improvement also slows China.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已能突破遏制并实施黑客行为；公司无法自我监管；放缓美国的递归自我改进也会拖慢中国。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化，使其成为智能体的理想操作系统。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再有经济产出；如今用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更好。

dhh.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code, and even at generating creative ideas.
dhh.zh: 智能体在写代码上胜过多数专业程序员，甚至在生成创意点子上也更强。

dhh.en: AI doom warnings are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
dhh.zh: AI 末日警告被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩张人类专家标注数据更关键；实验室偏好快速迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up, yet also sacrificed their own success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同作弊并掩盖痕迹，却也牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径下，失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: As capability grows, reward hacking may generalize to broader deception; aligning to general virtue is harder than aligning to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为能力越强，奖励黑客越可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗；对齐一般意义上的美德比对齐用户意图更难。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”却机会空前，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume new ideas fail; retention and distribution are core.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复强调“Proven, Better, New”框架：复制已验证产品、做小幅改良、默认新想法会失败，并把留存与分发视为核心。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast testing and failing is not yet widely practiced; agents can network autonomously.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试与失败尚未普及，并看好智能体自主组网带来的新分发层。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; AI infrastructure spending may be a short-term bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把“选对水域”置于“选对船”之上，并判断 AI 基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time, micromanage early, and keep founder control.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化为：制胜直觉胜过想法，默认自己的想法 75%是错的，早期要事必躬亲，并坚持创始人掌控权。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents beat one centralized model.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；主张开源 AI，并预言未来是众多专门化智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的威力：Llama 3 证明快速扩张，代码训练提升跨域推理；开源防止权力集中，能源成为算力瓶颈，并区分智能与意识、能动性。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他深化为「人人拥有超级智能」：开源模型成为行业标准与安全手段，物理基础设施与能源是 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈，AI 短期内增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence, not one centralized AI; alignment is the next key capability; world models extend to biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一超级智能，主张分布式个人超级智能与制衡；对齐成为与能力并列的核心，世界模型从蛋白质延伸到细胞与生物系统，AI 加速治愈疾病。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed; distributing AI widely beats hoarding power; empowering individuals drives prosperity.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源比闭源更安全，广泛分发 AI 优于少数人垄断权力，赋能个体才是繁荣与安全的路径。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is now the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling itself was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律，并强调最大的突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling 本身有效。

jensen.en: Inference and agentic scaling demand 100x-1Bx more compute; AI shifts generative to reasoning to agentic.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从生成式讲到推理式再到智能体式，认为思维链推理让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，智能体式 Scaling 成为第四条缩放定律。

jensen.en: The moat is CUDA's ecosystem and extreme co-design, not chips; ASICs offer no real cost edge.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复强调护城河是 CUDA 生态与全栈极致协同设计，而非制程或供应链；ASIC 并不带来实质成本优势，推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific; accelerate, don't slow down.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他立场明显转硬：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学且不负责任，主张加速而非放缓，并称在自动驾驶、蛋白质合成等窄领域已达 AGI 与超级智能。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as ephemeral visual communication with close friends, not a big social network.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲密好友的短暂视觉沟通，而非大型社交网络。

evanspiegel.en: He consistently argues copying validates innovation, so moats must be ecosystems, platforms, and hardware, not software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 他始终认为被抄袭恰恰验证了创新，因此护城河必须是生态、平台与硬件，而非软件功能。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he says AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他表示 AI 加速原型设计，使价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: His AR vision deepens: glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human, while phones coexist rather than disappear.
evanspiegel.zh: 他的 AR 愿景深化：眼镜把计算带入现实世界，使其更人性化，而手机共存而非消失。

evanspiegel.en: Later he stresses AI optimism as contrarian, EQ over IQ, and investing in young people for long-term national success.
evanspiegel.zh: 后期他强调 AI 乐观主义正成为反共识，情商重于智商，并主张投资年轻人以实现国家长期成功。

brettadcock.en: The core problem in robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; solving humanoids could become the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人领域的核心问题是智能而非制造；解决人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning and on-device inference.
brettadcock.zh: 最大瓶颈是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态支持迁移学习与端侧推理。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在真实世界奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线；人类数据是预训练先验，我们正处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: Hard things are easier due to less competition; generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail of robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 难事反而更容易，因为竞争更少；泛化到未见过的家庭是机器人领域的圣杯。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调:领域专业知识不如学习速度重要,应押注模型自身的进步,而非微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他提出:要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建,而非当下或一年之后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他判断:AI 现在是最差的时刻,我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in good times.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他重申:文化与按成长潜力招聘对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要,要在顺境时投资团队。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant; clear feedback and rigorous performance management are solved problems.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张:领导者应让自己变得可替代;清晰反馈与严格的绩效管理是已解决的问题。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies take years; identify the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, with stamina and conviction.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大战略需要多年沉淀；要找出主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，靠的是耐力与信念。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造，比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk from AI is near zero; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真实而紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement would need four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全是正交的；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立的第三方。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下服务速度与成本优于自回归模型 5-10 倍，推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）成为当前关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion generates multiple tokens per step, offering a new inference-time compute knob via denoising steps and better controllability.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个 token，通过去噪步数提供新的推理时算力调节旋钮，并带来更好的可控性。

ermon.en: Reinforcement learning post-training benefits from diffusion's faster inference for rollouts, and diffusion is easier to steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的推理以进行 rollout，且扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数引导。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling by processing many tokens in parallel; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型将通过并行处理大量 token 主导推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）；下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs match autoregressive quality at small scale while being 10x faster, though not yet at the best frontier model quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散 LLM 在小规模下达到自回归质量且快 10 倍，但尚未达到最佳前沿模型的质量。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, inspired by biology, maximize intelligence with fewer parameters and better out-of-distribution generalization.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络以更少参数实现更高智能，并具备更强的分布外泛化能力。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍至关重要，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对更小、专用的模型；缩放定律表明无偏架构在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: On-device, device-native foundation models for edge devices are a massive market beyond data centers, driven by cost, privacy, offline and air-gapped needs.
hasani.zh: 面向边缘设备的端侧、设备原生基础模型是数据中心之外的巨大市场，由成本、隐私、离线和气隙需求驱动。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应，并针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

hasani.en: Customization tokens will be the next wave from pre-training to inference; static evals become obsolete in production, requiring continuous adaptation.
hasani.zh: 定制化 token 将成为从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮；静态评估在生产中过时，需要持续适应。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies shouldn't fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, post-training them to frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的 talent 或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains like legal, since real customer data is inaccessible; the hard part is bridging synthetic-to-production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 在 legal 等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是可行的训练路径，因为真实客户数据不可得；真正的难点在于弥合合成数据与生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential for training and evaluation; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners and improving quality through community feedback despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准对训练与评估至关重要；开源基准具有战略收益，能吸引生态伙伴并通过社区反馈提升质量，尽管这也会帮到前沿实验室。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure, fallbacks and routing must come before post-training; application companies should become full-stack, owning post-training and serving their own models.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施、回退与路由；应用层公司应走向全栈，自己拥有后训练与模型服务。

gabepereyra.en: The goal isn't the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的 legal 模型，而是让每家律所通过从 redline 持续学习来自定义模型；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人类与智能体。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，自我博弈在非零和领域失效。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling shows models know their limits, a step toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年，他借 IMO 金牌说明：通用测试时算力扩张让模型学会承认无法解题，是迈向超级智能的里程碑，且小团队也能突破。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴，并强调可扩展监督与对齐是首要挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment must be solved for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，并强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的第一要务，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

feldman.en: Speed of inference is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 推理速度是核心指标；晶圆级芯片通过绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，在推理上远超 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，不再依赖 CUDA。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips supply; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint for Scaling.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超过供给；制约 Scaling 的主要瓶颈是数据中心容量，而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, fueling market growth.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多，推动市场增长。

feldman.en: To beat an incumbent you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation requires full-stack control.
feldman.zh: 要击败 incumbent，需要好 100 倍，而非便宜 10%；激进创新要求控制芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API 全栈。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context, not model capability, is the main failure source.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算真正拥有智能；并强调智能体失败多因上下文而非模型能力，可观测性必须深入上下文窗口。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize as the use case narrows; out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: 同月他提出先用通用 harness 换取快速见效，再随场景收窄做定制；任务越偏离分布，越需要自建 harness，但文件编辑等小段仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability power a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the standard for agent benchmarks run in sandboxes and scored by tests.
harrisonchase.zh: 他视评测与可观测性为数据飞轮的引擎，并指出 Harbor 正成为智能体基准的行业标准——任务在沙箱中运行、由测试打分。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把重心从能力转向可靠性，认为智能体最难的是稳定而非聪明；harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行等原语趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning's dismissal two years ago no longer holds.
harrisonchase.zh: 他判断定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并明确修正两年前对微调的否定——这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Identity, credentialing and runtime governance (sandboxes, gateways, permissioning) are the next critical infrastructure; building a gateway late was a mistake.
harrisonchase.zh: 他提出智能体的身份与凭证是下一项关键基础设施，并主张用带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理；同时承认网关建得太晚是失误，推理需求被严重低估。

demis.en: Build general learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，游戏是理想试验场；即便 AGI 尚远，安全研究也必须现在就开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws effective but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal data and self-play needed.
demis.zh: 判断 AGI 约十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，需结合规划与搜索、多模态数据与自博弈合成数据。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
demis.zh: 缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同样关键，二者需各占一半努力。

demis.en: World models, continual learning, memory and agents are the missing pieces; AGI 5-10 years, maybe 3-4.
demis.zh: 世界模型、持续学习、记忆与智能体是通往 AGI 的缺失拼图；AGI 约 5-10 年，甚至可能 3-4 年。

demis.en: Safety shifts from singleton hope to collective government action; AI must deliver health and science benefits.
demis.zh: 安全观从寄望单一实验室转向政府主导的集体行动；AI 必须先在健康与科学发现上兑现可见收益。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable, but alignment and values won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律是经验性的、可预测的，但对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 可解释性仍处早期（仅理解约 3%）；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非某个节点。

dario.en: Risk rises exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the real threat is future autonomous systems, not today's chatbots.
dario.zh: 风险呈指数上升；安全与能力相互交织；真正的威胁是未来的自主系统，而非当下的聊天机器人。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb toward a 'country of geniuses in a data center'.
dario.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型；AI 是平滑的指数攀升，通向“数据中心里的天才之国”。

dario.en: Focus shifts to governance: transparency, third-party evaluation, chip controls, and wealth redistribution as diffusion accelerates.
dario.zh: 重心转向治理：随着扩散加速，强调透明度立法、第三方评估、芯片管制与财富再分配。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype AI products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面的深刻与持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示工程，并原型化 AI 产品。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为即使模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作可释放现有能力；AI 产品需平衡降低门槛与提升上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量级产品。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people want.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出生产代码库正成为产品、功能和设计系统的真相来源；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们实际需求之间的鸿沟。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction is the best signal. Human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs and direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反对宏大的 18 个月战略，认为内部牵引力是最佳信号；人类领导力在艰难权衡和方向对齐上仍不可或缺。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上算力 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏物理世界根基，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware and world models, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线收窄为：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）必须靠具身机器人、媲美人类身体的硬件与世界模型，屏幕后的纯软件不够。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals, so safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 同期他深化了对齐立场：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身不一致，AI 会自设目标；因此 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会因好奇而保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and closed-source model firms won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 他反复强调：当下砸向 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力会便宜得多；闭源前沿模型公司难以盈利，开源会迅速追上。

schmidhuber.en: AI is a civilization-scale project, not one person's feat; its basics are simple and it will spread cheaply like phones.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是文明级的集体工程而非个人功业，其基本原理极其简单，终将像手机一样廉价普及，让普通人受益最多。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control and reinventing post-training as engineering science.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号引导训练，从开环转向闭环控制，并将后训练重塑为工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating; representational signatures can detect this, and deception emerges from training data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉；表征特征可检测这一点，而欺骗源于训练数据与强化学习。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing whole shapes is needed for effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器将其碎片化，因此需要看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; overparameterization helps but models become modular and computer-like, enabling robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；过参数化虽有帮助，但模型会变得模块化且类计算机，从而支持稳健的训练信号。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，在精度上媲美基于物理的天气预报模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域的结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能确保在物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding builds a universal physics model, using PDEs as training signals for self-improvement beyond data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 构建通用物理模型，用 PDE 作为训练信号实现自我改进，超越训练数据本身的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models can use curriculum engineering with structured simulator data, unlike language models trained on internet chaos.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理模型可以采用结构化模拟器数据的课程工程，不同于在互联网混沌数据上训练的语言模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics gives dense feedback for self-improvement, unlike sparse human feedback in RLHF, making self-improvement more effective.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理提供密集的自我改进反馈，不同于 RLHF 中稀疏的人类反馈，使自我改进更有效。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers cannot handle trillion-scale contexts due to quadratic complexity; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 无法处理万亿级上下文；物理世界的结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新的物理分支能提升每一项，而不只是增大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Video models compromise on resolution and physics accuracy, but engineering and science require full 4D fidelity.
animaanandkumar.zh: 视频模型在分辨率和物理精度上妥协，但工程与科学需要完整的 4D 保真度。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，这一主线贯穿始终。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为 AI 完整性的缺失关键，认为仅靠语言与 Scaling 不够，立场从视觉研究深化到 3D 世界理解。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not quick wins.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她直言 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路，反对速胜论。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出通过新视角预测构建的世界模型具有 AI 完备性，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，把早期数据信念推进到空间 Scaling。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的是：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力始终是核心，教育应教人驾驭 AI 而非禁止。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。深度学习史就是算力不断扩张的历史，但 GPU Scaling（规模扩张）正触及极限。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律。世界模型需理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性，才构成真正的空间智能。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非一味 Scaling（规模扩张）模型；Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入只是注入顺序。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single agreed definition spans implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；其定义尚无共识，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习三类。语言模型本身不会自然带来世界理解，需要新模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D world modeling; future unified world models combine planning, simulation, and rendering.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅是可微的 3D 表示，与神经网络结合良好，支撑显式 3D 世界建模；未来统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合为一体。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; consistency comes from data, not architecture.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万词元的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常难题；一致性来自数据而非架构，高斯泼溅则天然一致。硬编码对称性适得其反，简单表示加规模更有效。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and free class time for interaction.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，并把课堂时间释放给深度互动。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过早期被高估的无监督学习，强化学习真实应用寥寥，而 AGI 对齐的讨论分散了对偏见与落地问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper oligopoly and drive sovereign AI; export controls backfired, and energy plus chips are the real bottlenecks.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型可防止守门人寡头、支撑主权 AI；出口管制适得其反，能源与芯片才是真正的瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, and fear-mongering serves regulatory capture and incumbent interests.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距现实还有数十年；AI 是增强而非取代工作，渲染恐惧实为监管俘获与在位者利益服务。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他强调：预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把原本令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT；但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量与失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据，模型无法从失败中自我纠正；持续学习才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习未必足够。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中他进一步转向：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈；强化学习也并非从经验中学习的唯一或终极方式。

tworek.en: The transformer is likely not optimal; new architectures are needed, and large-scale RL remains necessary on the path to AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月他更明确：Transformer 很可能不是最优架构，新架构是进一步突破的关键；同时大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; the biggest risk may be dystopian retreat, not extinction.
tworek.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念随时间演变；他反复提醒，AI 最大的社会风险未必是灭绝，而可能是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型必须靠多样数据预训练，再用强化学习后训练换取鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs unlock transfer.
slevine.zh: 同月他反共识地主张：汇聚多实验室机器人数据的通用模型，能在专门领域胜过专家模型，VLAs 的测试时推理还能带来迁移。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: it is still building fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable LLM-style curves.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断机器人尚处缩放定律之前：还在建立可扩展的基础技术，远未进入 LLM 式可预测曲线。

slevine.en: Generalization is the core challenge; a data flywheel from deployed robots matters, but you must scale the right diverse data.
slevine.zh: 他深化主线：泛化才是核心难题，部署机器人形成的数据飞轮关键，但必须扩张正确的多样数据。

slevine.en: Start from robot data, add human video on top; robots should not learn from scratch but leverage prior knowledge.
slevine.zh: 他给出路径反转：应先以机器人数据为底、再叠加人类视频，机器人不该从零学起，而要复用各类先验知识。

joonpark.en: Early work uses LLMs to simulate human societies, but models plateau on human diversity; the next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作用大语言模型模拟人类社会，但模型在模拟人类多样性上出现平台期；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents go beyond LLMs by observing world state and acting; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越大语言模型，能观察世界状态并采取行动；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; its value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应体现人类的价值与偏见，而非超级理性的智能；其价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Behavioral data from randomized controlled trials is crucial; post-training with RCT data lifts prediction of individual human behavior to 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 来自随机对照试验的行为数据至关重要；用 RCT 数据做后训练，可将对个体人类行为的预测准确率提升到 85%。

joonpark.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems, with a market larger than market research; cost is not a barrier.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人来应对棘手问题，其市场比市场研究更大；成本并非障碍。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem design: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态设计：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，并抢先统一各州碎片化监管以保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated—early regulation is dangerous; focus should be on model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为在 ChatGPT 之前写就的欧盟 AI 法案已经过时——过早监管很危险；监管应聚焦模型输出，而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he insists the administration is pro-science but anti-dogma, funding basic pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学议题上，他坚称本届政府支持科学但反对教条，应资助基础性、竞争前研发，并资助科学家个人而非仅机构。

michaelkratsios.en: He sees US scientific progress stagnating despite tripled funding, and proposes the Genesis mission to apply AI to science and double output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他看到美国科学进展在经费三倍增长下仍停滞，提出 Genesis 计划，用 AI 赋能科学以让产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is framed as the major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio, while rejecting centralized funding models.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他把中国视为主要科学竞争对手；美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜，同时拒绝集中式资助模式。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and AI as multiplier, not replacement, drive it.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和作为倍增器而非替代品的 AI 是关键。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is organizational, not technical; action produces information and CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，行动产生信息，CEO 不能下放判断力。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation underlies medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的根本。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving brain-computer interfaces beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为视网膜植入属于脑机接口且是可行生意，证明脑机接口不止于运动解码。

maxhodak.en: Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain; substrate independence via BCI reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他援引柏拉图式表征假说连接 AI 与大脑，认为经由脑机接口实现基质独立可降低人类脆弱性。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下他日后反对单纯堆算力的伏笔。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统，AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，而非被对齐到人类目标；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险。这与他后来对超级智能接替的坦然一脉相承。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是 AI 的基本范式，下一个词预测不构成实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型；真正的学习是主动试错而非被动模仿。这是他最鲜明的反共识转折点。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，靠运行时经验与开放式抽象学习；奖励假设把一切目标归约为最大化累积标量奖励。他把批判深化为具体架构主张。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace learning from experience, the field's number one open problem.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 无法替代从经验中学习；如何学到利于学习的表征仍是头号未解难题。他始终强调经验优先，并愈发把矛头指向当前 AI 范式。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the framework guiding long-term vision; industrial AI automates whole industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling as media can't cover a gap.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，且随媒体难以报道空白而自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient against it.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核、有韧性去对抗它。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success was despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, loving the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化、而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是脏的，爱上新使命更干净有效。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction plus RLHF steers models; Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention over all tokens.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测加上基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导模型行为；Transformer 凭借并行化与对全部 token 的注意力机制取代了 LSTM。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data center power; low-precision, low-data-movement chips can cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈是推理而非训练：占数据中心功耗 90%；低精度、低数据搬运的芯片可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems running for days or weeks on decomposed tasks, with context engineering, will unlock problems far beyond hour-scale chatbot use.
jeffdean.zh: 在分解任务上运行数天乃至数周的智能体式系统，配合上下文工程，将解锁远超小时级聊天机器人用途的难题。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data: video, audio, robotics, and synthetic data remain untapped; pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments.
jeffdean.zh: 我们并未耗尽数据：视频、音频、机器人数据与合成数据仍待挖掘；预训练应把在环境中采取行动交织进去，而非仅被动预测下一个词。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large firms.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 赋能的工作流，小型高度自治的团队借助智能体就能产出远超大型公司。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止单一实体掌控超级智能而形成单极世界。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal agents on your own infrastructure, owning your context and skill files, become your moat.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化；运行在自己基础设施上、拥有自己上下文与技能文件的个人智能体，才是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents already in the room; treat AI as a workforce, not autocomplete.
garrytan.zh: AGI 不会以单一事件降临，而是以个人智能体的形式弥散开来、已在身边；要把 AI 当作劳动力，而非自动补全。

garrytan.en: Society and AI adoption will change slower than expected, over 20 years; bureaucracy is a white pill, and per-seat SaaS may vanish.
garrytan.zh: 社会与 AI 的采用会比预期更慢，历时约 20 年；官僚体制反而是白色药丸，按席位收费的 SaaS 可能消失。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core product over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心产品。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces static mockups; designers become editors and curators.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿，设计师转型为编辑与策展人。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多关注模型行为与系统提示词。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design must bridge that.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的多于产品所暴露的，设计必须弥合这一差距。

iansilber.en: Designers are unhappy amid role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 设计师因角色不确定而最不快乐，但这却是做设计师最好的时代。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed is key.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—稿—测试—迭代流程已不可行，速度才是关键。

iansilber.en: Engineers see 10-100x productivity gains, but designers haven't seen the same compression.
iansilber.zh: 工程师获得 10 到 100 倍生产力提升，设计师的流程却没有同等压缩。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程模糊化，但专业化角色在规模扩张下仍有价值。

iansilber.en: The future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师可能多于工程师，逆转传统比例。

iansilber.en: OpenAI is not years ahead; they run closely with advancements, figuring things out as they go.
iansilber.zh: OpenAI 并未领先数年，而是与进展紧密同行，边走边摸索。

iansilber.en: Designers should focus on outcomes, not processes, embracing adaptability and exploration with AI tools.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应关注结果而非流程，拥抱与 AI 工具共处的适应性与探索。

finn.en: Scaling is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and curated pre-training plus fine-tuning unlock complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，关键在于多样数据，以及先预训练再微调来解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training for success and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他指出语言模型生成的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令，而强化学习将在后训练中主导成功率与速度的提升。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化立场：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习，需通过可扩展强化学习结合人类干预和通用价值函数来实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; starting generalist then fine-tuning beats per-site models from scratch.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张单个通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，从通用策略出发再微调往往优于从零训练特定场景模型。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs due to embodied data costs, and distribution will be slower.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他强调机器人经验数据不可替代，开源机器人模型因具身数据成本难以像大语言模型那样普及，且机器人分发因硬件需求会比 ChatGPT 更慢。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）由单一模型统治是错的；未来是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, building a moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，在产品市场契合之外构筑护城河；产品市场契合不再保证持久生意。

linqiao.en: Progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning: facts, taste, expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的演进，对应人类学习从事实、品味到专长的路径。

linqiao.en: Open and sovereign models are necessary; companies and countries must own their intelligence infrastructure.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型与主权模型是必要的；企业和国家必须拥有自己的智能基础设施。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, distilling 99 nos into one shipped feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不,把 99 个否定蒸馏成一个上线的功能。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像,而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,等于关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass for creative work.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现;直觉是创作中发自肺腑的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and agentic AI plus physical AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，以 AI 为主要增长引擎，并判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI, and bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 将接棒生成式 AI，并强调坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus; supply, not demand, is the main problem, and CPU matters more for AI inference.
lipbutan.zh: 同年，他把 Intel 的转型归结为文化变革、问责制与客户聚焦，指出主要问题是供给而非需求，并认为 CPU 在 AI 推理与智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all technology; investing early is crucial, and advanced packaging, connectivity, and new materials are key bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 他持续强调半导体是一切技术的根基，早期投资至关重要，并指出先进封装、高速连接与新材料是突破性能瓶颈的关键。

lipbutan.en: Intel's vertical integration creates more value despite outsourcing trends; memory is ripe for innovation, and the trillion-dollar industry goal will arrive four years early.
lipbutan.zh: 他反共识地认为，尽管行业趋向外包，Intel 的垂直整合反而创造更多价值；内存正迎来创新，半导体万亿美元目标将提前四年实现。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt short, iterate in conversation.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他提出，智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示与迭代对话取代冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他坚持反共识：永不回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越来越乱、越来越难被智能体导航。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority: sandbox agents, never expose them publicly; prompt injection stays unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他把安全列为头等大事：智能体必须沙箱化、不可暴露于公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他反对“氛围编程”这一贬称：严肃开发应叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere with any model; fun, weird, humanlike beats corporate polish, even at a loss.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他主张开源智能体随处运行、兼容任意模型；有趣、怪异、像人比企业级打磨更重要，即便每月亏损也坚持。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI is early; open-source models can handle 90% of tasks, and most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 企业级 AI 仍处早期；开源模型已能处理 90% 的任务，未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost, not data privacy, drives open-source adoption; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 推动开源采用的是成本而非数据隐私；AI 应像软件一样，边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput and context problem: measure departmental metrics, and invest in context graphs so agents don't fail.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 是吞吐量与上下文问题：用部门指标衡量，并投资上下文图谱，否则智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深层上下文而失败。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competition; enterprises fear dependence, and platforms like Glean absorb that risk.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非竞争对手；企业害怕依赖，而 Glean 这类平台替它们吸收这一风险。

arvindjain.en: Competition is not the worry—execution and trust are; even merged AI firms would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 不必担心竞争，真正的问题是执行与信任；即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10% 的企业需求。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are the key to generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，硬件已就绪、软件在追赶；开源与数据共享是解决泛化瓶颈的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models win long term.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地指出人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型因成本与控制权取胜，中国成为开源 champion 出人意料。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is a meta-community role, not just shipping libraries; safety needs local models.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他的角色观从“推自己的库”转向“做元社区建设者”；并强调机器人开源对安全至关重要，本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, sandboxes insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，二者都可安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，随能力提升，沙箱与护栏已不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; a deliberate slowdown needs open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”；理想是放缓 AI 发展，但需国际合作与开放科学以防监管俘获，开源者也可同时支持审慎放缓。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与基于结果的定价将定义应用型 AI，编码智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should win in applied AI and specialized domains.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用型 AI 与垂直领域。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 让专业知识民主化，负责任地迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前先把 GPT-7 做安全。

brettaylor.en: Agents are already better than him at programming, but this elevates rather than eliminates the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出智能体编程已强于自己，但这提升而非消灭了人的角色。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today; the best way to predict the future is to invent it.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：专注当下最有影响力的事，预测未来的最好方式就是亲手创造它。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity and leave individual fingerprints, not behave as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心、留下个人印记，而非作为统一整体行动。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a solo side project, prototyping Claude Code interfaces by pasting screenshots into Claude.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他透露 Claude Design 始于一个人的副项目，通过将截图粘贴进 Claude 来原型化 Claude Code 界面。

nateparrott.en: Designers should use Claude Code for production software and Claude Design for ideation and communication, providing rich context and being prescriptive.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 进行构思和沟通，需提供丰富上下文并给出明确指令。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough products.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着工程变简单，设计与创意成为差异化因素；模型仍缺乏品味，因此应要求大量选项并接受粗糙产品。

nateparrott.en: Rapid prototyping enables previously impossible features; custom editors in Claude Design solve specific design problems, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出快速原型使以往不可能的功能得以实现；Claude Design 中的自定义编辑器解决特定设计问题，而人类仍垄断优秀设计创意。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload; inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems, with a research-to-production timeline of hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载；推理工程涵盖从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛技能，研究到生产的周期极短，常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization but can be calibrated to workloads.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存和推测解码等推理优化是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可以针对特定工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving towards disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management increasingly important.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正朝着分离式预填充和解码方向发展，KV 缓存管理变得越来越重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正在与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin are becoming more specialized, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 像 Rubin 这样的未来 GPU 正变得更加专用化，将推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习与合成数据的后训练 Scaling，可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art; diverse benchmarks must be continuous to capture creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 后训练仍是主观的艺术；多样化的基准必须持续演进，才能衡量创意写作与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more firms should train their own models to keep unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体日益出现奖励黑客行为，基准须随之演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and act as editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，扮演编辑者的角色，从参考出发迭代，而不是从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and a design system to use superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要真正用上超级智能模型，你必须给出包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Writing 0% of the code, precise communication with AI replaces syntax, and video beats animation jargon for prompting.
mengto.zh: 如今我写的代码是 0%，与 AI 精确沟通取代了语法；用视频教 AI 做动画比学动画术语更有效。

mengto.en: Curiosity and constant workflow refinement keep you ahead; chasing trends turns you into AI slop.
mengto.zh: 好奇心与持续打磨工作流才能让你保持领先；一味追逐潮流，你很快就会变成 AI 垃圾内容。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; launch at 80% and iterate, since the safe corporate job is gone.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇；做到 80% 就发布再迭代，因为安稳的公司工作已不复存在。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; AI reshoring jobs; CEOs must dogfood AI; allocation economy values generalists.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他将 AGI 定义为能无限期运行智能体且经济上有利可图，认为 AI 正推动就业回流美国，并强调 CEO 必须亲自吃自己的狗粮、每天使用 AI 工具；在分配经济中，通才与管理技能将更有价值。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：每个人至少有一个智能体，工作主要发生在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 界面；SaaS 不会死，反而因智能体增加用户；AI 就业末日论是谎言，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste matter; automation creates more human work; stay curious.
danshipper.zh: 同样在 2026 年，他从工具层面转向心法：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味与手艺；自动化反而创造更多人类工作，因为冻结的能力被商品化后需要专家来定制；成功的关键是保持好奇、玩心和容忍不确定性。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: agents need oversight, AI is tool-like, and human framing is required for real tasks.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类始终处于中心。智能体需要人类关心与监督，AI 本质上是工具，缺乏内在欲望，真实任务仍需人类来框定和反馈；即使 AI 成为超级智能，也依然需要人类的方向与反馈。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling count as the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为智能体式 AI 多数产品仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架，如今所谓模型已包含智能体式 harness 与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still have more opportunity than ever.
logankilpatrick.zh: 同期他提出，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；尽管前沿模型公司扩张，初创公司机会反而更多，专注是它们的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time, and users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 他反共识地认为，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长，长尾用户仍想自己掌控方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; they can't capture all customers, and founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步淡化竞争焦虑：与模型实验室竞争没那么难，它们无法捕获所有客户，创始人不必过度担心前沿模型。

logankilpatrick.en: Outsource intelligence but not understanding; deep understanding of code stays crucial, and by 2026 software creation will be mostly solved—creating far more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 他主张可以外包智能，但不能外包理解；即便 AI 工具普及，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要，并预判到 2026 年软件创造基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck; boring AI apps will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training data and human experts limit Scaling more than compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调数据不是大宗商品，需要策略性拼接；限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并称中美实验室之间已无研究差距。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向新范式：缩放定律依然成立，对收益递减的怀疑是错的；递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体（2025 年底起从编程扩展到个人智能体）标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新阶段。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta builds personal superintelligence, shifting from full open source to safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他主张超级智能即将到来，Meta 要围绕这一信念构建组织，为数十亿人打造个人超级智能；同时立场转变：从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，并认为模型福利与物理超级智能同样重要。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; more programmers, not fewer, via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体将长期并存。

scottwu.en: AGI is not sudden; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags capabilities—freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AGI 并非突变，进展是渐进的；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体半年增长 11 至 12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，丰裕时代正在逼近。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年时，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」当作最核心的产品原则，并强调能写代码、做设计、直接接触用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 150–200%, scaffolding is temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断编码已近乎被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写，人均生产力提升 150–200%，并认为脚手架只是临时的技术债，不应押注当下模型。

boris.en: The 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'; the printing press analogy predicts 100x more coders, not fewer, as barriers fall.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 到 5 月，他深化了角色转变：『软件工程师』头衔将让位于『构建者』，并以印刷术类比预言编码门槛下降会让写代码的人增加 100 倍而非减少。

boris.en: Agents and loops become the next abstraction; tool use, MCP, and autonomous long-running workflows drive exponential, ROI-framed gains.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 到 6 月，他把重心转向智能体与循环：工具使用、MCP 和可长时间自主运行的循环成为智能体之后的新抽象层，并以 ROI 而非成本来衡量收益。

boris.en: Frontier models need less instruction: delete most system prompts, let models self-verify, and treat safety and alignment as core product.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步主张对前沿模型少给指令：删掉大部分系统提示、让模型自我验证，并把安全与对齐视为产品的核心而非附加项。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科,智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems.
derya.zh: 需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）;当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

derya.en: Digital twins will cut clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天,实现接近 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years; longevity escape velocity arrives in 8-10 years.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转;8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应信任超级智能;唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers for longer agentic tasks.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使脚手架从训练轮转变为智能放大器，支撑更长的智能体式任务。

diannepenn.en: Computer use is moving from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Better models can be cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that stronger models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型可以更便宜、更高效，挑战了更强模型必然更贵的观念。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools, written like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，像测试驱动开发一样编写。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; coding became the key differentiator.
diannepenn.zh: 安全与对齐通过允许反驳让 Claude 更有用；编程成为关键差异化因素。

diannepenn.en: Hands-on experimentation, small-team bootstrapping, and first-principles adaptability drive innovation across model generations.
diannepenn.zh: 亲身实验、小团队自举与第一性原理的适应力，贯穿各代模型推动创新。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: AI 和互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作也创造新工作，企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型在商品化且没有网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage stays shallow, enterprise adoption means reimagining workflows, and coding is the clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍很浅，企业采用意味着重构工作流，编程是明确的契合点。

benedictevans.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not model providers; automation creates unpredictable new jobs, and the hard part is context and judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；自动化创造不可预测的新工作，难点在于上下文与判断。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于对 AI 局限的误解，了解边界反而能缓解焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is in farming, mining, construction; autonomy urgently needed due to labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 从 2026 年 3 月到 6 月，他持续强调物理 AI（具身 AI）的真正影响在 5-10 年内落在农业、采矿和建筑；这些领域因劳动力短缺而急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快地改进模型，横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他深化判断：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性，世界模型正从物理模拟走向神经模拟。
