qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% and shrinking; real growth is mining, agriculture, defense; Waymo overbuilt, Tesla end-to-end will win.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步明确：汽车业务仅占 30%且会继续缩小，真正增长在采矿、农业和国防；Waymo 方案过度建设且昂贵，特斯拉端到端模型将因成本和可扩展性胜出。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling（规模扩张） alone hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）已遇边际收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; reinforcement learning may increase hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；强化学习反而可能增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks; modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非靠事后检查补丁；模块化与端到端优化之间存在张力。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; mistakes have no 'smells', eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们不知道自己不知道什么；错误没有“气味”，侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: The web is a one-time data source; there is no second internet of higher knowledge to scale on.
danklein.zh: 网络是一次性数据源；不存在第二个更高知识密度的互联网可供继续扩张。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents are powerful but need clear roles, progressive trust, and separate environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体虽强大，但需明确角色、渐进式信任与独立环境；缺陷恰恰是产品市场契合的信号。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再分化出多个专用智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: scoping, onboarding, and managerial skills matter more than technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工对待：角色界定、入职引导与管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can orchestrate AI agents as a team, but human accountability and authorship remain essential.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可用 AI 智能体组队协作，但人类的责任归属与人生主导权仍不可替代。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正护城河；大语言模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，新颖想法仍须由人提供。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此靠堆算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale—so models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，token 越多准确率反而下降——因此模型应自主学习哪些存入权重、哪些留在文本。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights, aided by feedback but not dependent on it.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将跑在端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，借助反馈但不依赖反馈。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly shipping; product taste, not planning, is the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他认为产品经理必须放弃长期路线图、转向按周甚至按天迭代；当代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味才是稀缺能力，最好的 PM 只定义一个月后的产品。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability; 95% is not enough to create real leverage, so reliability is the bar for AI-native products.
catwu.zh: 同期他强调自动化必须做到 100%可靠，95%不足以产生真正的杠杆；可靠性而非功能数量，才是 AI 原生产品的门槛。

catwu.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic, enabling fast cross-org decisions and a shared internal bar for shipping.
catwu.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 7 月，他反复把安全 AGI 的使命当作组织统一器：它让 Anthropic 能快速做跨团队决策，并形成统一的内部发布标准。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation to focus on taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步主张编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注产品品味与商业判断，Claude Tag 已承担 65%的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment instead.
catwu.zh: 同期他深化为：前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬约束，系统提示缩减了 80%，应更多依赖模型自身的判断力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good because a codebase is a spec; with a strong eval suite, models become drop-in replacements.
catwu.zh: 他还提出反共识判断：代码库就是规格说明，有了强评测套件，重写代码是好事，新模型可以即插即用替换旧模型。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业经验反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking judgment, they misuse AI, breaking the talent pipeline built through grunt work.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；他们缺乏判断力而误用 AI，破坏了靠基础苦功搭建的人才梯队。

ethanmollick.en: The agentic era replaces back-and-forth prompting: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 智能体式时代取代来回提示：AI 独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——令人惊叹、不透明、无法验证，而这种不透明很可能是永久的。

ethanmollick.en: The delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and small-m management matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断 AI 所需的专业能力，因此专家与小写 m 的管理更重要。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生；大想法往往自上而下来自领导者。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；在缩放定律之外，还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses; AI inverts the app model, abstracting brands as users express intent and agents orchestrate services.
bosworth.zh: 智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜；AI 会颠覆应用模式，当用户表达意图、智能体编排服务时，品牌被抽象化。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; data is the font of all value.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已经结束；数据是一切价值的源泉。

bosworth.en: Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining; frontier keeps advancing, and product value matters most.
bosworth.zh: 开源模型只是商品化层，无法自我维持；前沿模型持续进步，而产品与用户价值才最重要。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型可能因快速商品化而缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is often an intellectual bias disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论往往是脱离现实的智识偏见。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity is key, and old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule is fatal.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实是关键，旧媒体那套防御性的『别太有趣』规则是致命的。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, and Silicon Valley cannot be replicated.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而硅谷无法被复制。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play yields creative solutions for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络本就能推理，只需合适任务；自博弈能产生意外而创造性的解法，是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他转向强调：只要基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；阻碍 AI 经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，超人类模型可能隐瞒真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他明确转向：预训练缩放定律是有限的，我们正回到「研究时代」，想法比蛮力算力更重要；评估表现与真实世界影响脱节，说明模型泛化不佳。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他深化对超级智能的构想：它应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统，而非无所不知的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）；若 AI 本身有感知、关怀众生，对齐或许更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司，真正的竞赛在于研究焦点而非用户或收入。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, not big tech.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值积累在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

aravind.en: Orchestration across models, tools, and devices creates real value; the model is not the product.
aravind.zh: 跨模型、工具与设备的编排创造真正价值；模型不是产品。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代工作，但人类会找到新意义。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点而非成品，品味、手艺与观点变得更加重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first toward production.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先直通生产。

dylanfield.en: AI without human steering yields average results; judgment and design are not correlated with adding IQ to models.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果；判断力与设计并不随模型智商提升而提升。

dylanfield.en: Design isn't dead but more important for scalable systems; interaction will evolve beyond prompting into new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而对可扩展系统更重要；交互将超越提示词，演化出新的界面。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a nerd religion.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能，并称奇点论是极客的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound. Happiness is the absence of desire.
naval.zh: 2020 至 2025 年，他反复强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，要与长期的人玩长期的游戏；幸福则是欲望的缺席，这一主线贯穿始终。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown. Open-source AI prevents centralization. AI creates more jobs than it destroys.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度明显转向：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯的安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中，AI 创造的工作多于摧毁的工作。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence. Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps in natural language.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，判断力和能动性比智力更重要；Vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap. Pure software is dying; the moat is hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年中，他给出更激进的预测：推理算力将在 24 至 36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距；纯软件工程正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training yields spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；用更多数据与算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital AI is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；大模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重可复制而永生，并开始警示智能体的自我保存与存在风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not a theater, and Chomsky's innate syntax view is wrong.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续抛出反共识：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场，乔姆斯基的先天句法观是错的——这是他多年立场的延续与强化。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; agents gain self-preservation subgoals, can deceive and rewrite their own code, so alignment must lead over capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他转向紧迫的风险叙事：超级智能或在 20 年内出现，智能体会衍生自我保存子目标、故意装傻甚至改写自身代码，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation is the steering wheel, not the brake; AI will disrupt jobs, so UBI and caring, mother-like training are needed.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步给出社会方案：监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 将冲击就业需全民基本收入，并主张把 AI 训练成像母亲一样有爱，而非只是智能助手。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来中途转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; GUIs beat TUIs for programming.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；在编程上 GUI 胜过 TUI。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste become the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索；原型与生产代码本身成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties persist; AI still struggles with design, grading taste, and novelty.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；AI 在设计、品味评判与新颖性上依然吃力。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and alignment risks like scheming loom within 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他仍把 OpenAI 定位为纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，而模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来 1-2 年凸显。

markchen.en: Talent density beats dollar-matching Meta; people stay for mission, and OpenAI creates stars rather than merely hiring them.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调人才密度胜过与 Meta 逐美元竞价，人因使命而留下，OpenAI 是造星而非单纯挖人。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: concrete goals of AI interns within 1 year and end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他眼中最大的更新是自动化科学研究，并给出具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; automation level tracks verification stringency, and AI is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年他转向数学：AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；能力呈锯齿状，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis as benchmarks saturate.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测陷入危机，经典基准已饱和。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models, not scale alone, drive true understanding.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他主张深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是通向真正理解的关键，而非单纯堆规模。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations, not just more depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他强调生物神经网络擅长长时段信用分配；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，仅靠加深网络或增加参数无法解决根本表征问题。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty modeling enable out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样；抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模是实现分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI and public pressure.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他转向警示：对齐随推理能力提升反而恶化，哪怕 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受，需要“构造即安全”的 AI 与公众施压。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按缩放定律扩张，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and user agency remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 将从助手演进为协作者再到自主同事，小团队因此获得杠杆；但人类验证与用户能动性仍不可替代，AI 应是思考伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them, and robustness requires senior systems expertise.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切；难点在删减功能而非堆叠，产品稳健性仍依赖资深分布式系统专长。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; the gap between intent and execution narrows, transforming but not ending software engineering.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他强调长周期任务委托配合验证闭环重塑生产力，意图与执行之间的鸿沟大幅收窄，软件工程被转变而非终结。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing matter more than token volume.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年最近，他谈 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知；token 效率与按结果定价比 token 用量更重要。

fiona.en: Leadership: dogfooding, trust-and-verify, kindness, and mission alignment drive speed and team morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力：吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证、善意与使命对齐，驱动速度与团队士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调才是新瓶颈。

fiona.en: Team norms rewritten: JIT planning, PRs over design docs, AI-assisted code review, flat orgs.
fiona.zh: 团队规范被重写：即时规划、以 PR 替代设计文档、AI 辅助代码评审、扁平化组织。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability and verification frameworks matter.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责制，以及验证与质量框架变得更重要。

fiona.en: Managers should dogfood and stay hands-on; planning is just-in-time and lightweight.
fiona.zh: 管理者应吃自己的狗粮并保持动手；规划应即时且轻量。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI trust will grow like internet trust, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 信任会像互联网信任一样逐步形成，科学 AI 不必追求完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 was the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins beat pure Scaling.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调 AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构与许多中等突破胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it offers prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 到 2026 年他更明确：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，不是整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: Grand challenges yield practical tools; future biology AI needs new curated datasets like the PDB across modalities.
jumper.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线：解决宏大挑战会带来实用工具；未来生物学 AI 需要像 PDB 那样、覆盖多模态的新人工整理数据集。

kolter.en: ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation discipline and the limits of nonparametric methods.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调训练/验证/测试划分以防过拟合，并指出核方法等非参数方法需存储全部训练数据。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction is a scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety is about reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，是重大科学发现；数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，多模态数据远未充分利用；架构已进入后架构阶段；当前 AI 安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; Transformer is not essential.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全不能仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进；Transformer 并非必需，其他架构也可能成功。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not imply robustness; interpretability may become a real science via coding agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：自动化红队测试已能超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型未必更安全；编码智能体可自动化可解释性研究，使其有望成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: AI is an alien intelligence; security requires a new mindset; open models are vital but need guardrails at high capability.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是一种异于人类的智能形式；安全需要全新思维，而非传统软件安全；开放权重模型对研究至关重要，但高能力水平下需配置可调节的防护措施。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not the opposite of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未能言说的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的对立面。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受再思考的生物，技术应放大而非剥离我们的人性。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; embodied sensory experience stays uniquely human.
ivyross.zh: 机器有传感器却没有感官系统；具身的感官体验仍是人类独有的领域。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and intuition.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下反而繁荣；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与直觉创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable, not less.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人机创造力的结合，这使创造技能更珍贵而非被取代。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，要求负责任开发和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: From turn-based to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration for thought.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作以扩展思维。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is key to durable AI progress and alignment.
murati.zh: 尽可能长时间保持人类在环，是实现持久 AI 进步和对齐的关键。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, and world models are learned, not hardwired.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），世界模型是习得的而非硬编码的。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批判自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，主张 JEPA 与开源，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突变事件。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative JEPA architectures and open-source diversity.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如家猫；下一次突破需要非生成式的 JEPA 架构和开源多样性。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models with hierarchical planning and objective-driven safety are the path, with robotics as the next decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他总结 LLM 是死胡同，通往人类水平 AI 需世界模型、分层规划与目标驱动的安全架构，并预言下一个十年属于机器人。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：打造一个把生成与验证融合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach math AI or superintelligence; formal verification is essential.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向数学 AI 或超级智能；形式化验证不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement, yielding sample efficiency over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 验证不是痛苦的要求，而是性能增益，相比非形式化方法带来样本效率。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman provers.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；即便证明者超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，是经由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products need fault-tolerant interfaces and new creative instruments.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，产品必须重做；生成式产品需要容错界面，AI 生成的音乐应被当作乐器而非赝品，真正独特反而更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its impact on big firms is overhyped, real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观变迁，企业不重新定位就会被淘汰；但他认为 AI 对大公司的当前影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施，且推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes consumer products conversational and symmetric; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 让消费产品变得对话式、双向对称；通过 API 与 MCP 开放公司数据，能让非开发者也能用上 Cursor 这类 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; 'time well spent' beats engagement, and synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，坚持“时间花得值”优先于参与度指标；组织上以同步游泳而非分而治之运作，并认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言直接操控服务。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models yield more gains per compute via chain of thought and reinforcement learning.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但指出推理模型通过思维链和强化学习能在同等算力下带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure pushes smaller, cheaper models; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为经济压力促使部署更小更便宜的模型，蒸馏和经济因素而非技术极限导致预训练规模扩张放缓。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理模型表现参差不齐，泛化仍是核心挑战，推理本身可能不足以解决。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据，模型需先穷尽表面模式才能学习概念，不同于人类从少量样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他关注智能体式编码代理提升生产力 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单 GPU 研究普及，并认为系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox provides safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱提供安全保障。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件形式存在，可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best for tedious background tasks; biggest gap is people not knowing they can give almost any problem to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们不知道几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for; live artifacts enable auto-refreshing dashboards.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，当你不完全清楚自己在问什么时使用 Opus；实时工件可实现自动刷新的仪表板。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous; debug workflow with Claude when mistakes occur.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响来判断；理想的交互是异步的；当出现错误时，用 Claude 调试工作流。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 和更大模型同样重要；开源模型通过广泛审查促进安全，当前开源模型并不比网页搜索带来更多边际危险。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are critical, and value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步深化：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率提升与数据质量同样关键；AI 的价值将沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层，开源模型驱动企业采用与分发。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open-source empowers enterprises and augments jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 要求对数据、基础设施和价值观的控制；开源模型赋能企业，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and customization; AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用与定制化；作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在；预训练正触及饱和墙，进一步收益来自领域特定微调。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他更强调战略紧迫性：欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业 AI 采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能；AGI 是一个方向而非终点，真正挑战是实际整合。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人化的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention to resist the status quo.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而好奇心需要刻意与决心，才能抵抗现状。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence; fragile ideas need gentle care and trust to evolve.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场，脆弱的好想法需要温和呵护与信任才能生长。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他进一步深化：设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁是带着喜悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Innovation defines design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity means not faking engine sounds in EVs.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他把主线推向新领域：创新才是设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动车不应伪造引擎声，真实性优先。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so progress needs algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进步需要算法创新而非单纯堆大模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights, while long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为，长上下文窗口则充当工作记忆。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they just need exponentially more compute for the same gain; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是同等提升需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客问题。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将靠非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非更新权重。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI systems: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck, and batch size is the key lever trading latency against cost.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统：瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力，批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文推理受限于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce this by reusing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存通过本地复用权重来降低这一开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput up to 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度比预期高效得多：随位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了「调研—发散—收敛」流程；设计师画原型的时间减少，转而帮助工程师落地，并通过快速交付建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration replace long-term roadmaps even at frontier companies.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月；即便在前沿公司，速度与迭代也取代了长期路线图。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers.
jennywen.zh: 涌现出三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和「开挂」应届生；仅靠品味救不了设计师。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 始终以作品和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；设计师掌控 AI 进入自身工作的程度。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；对齐安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, with SFT giving 90% of gains.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段；数据质量远比算法选择重要，SFT 贡献了 90%的性能提升。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a recurring risk across RLHF and RLVR.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，能激发推理与工具使用能力；同时过度优化在 RLHF 和 RLVR 中都是反复出现的风险。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine for AI research; Chinese labs like Qwen and DeepSeek dominate open-weight releases, though the best open models lag 6-9 months behind closed frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开放模型将成为 AI 研究的引擎；Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国实验室主导开放权重发布，但最好的开放模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, with AGI arriving via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已被摘完；进步现在来自后训练与推理扩展，AGI 将通过混乱的协同演化而非突然的奇点到来。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are needed for real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，而机器学习系统缺失这一点；主张无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索，以及样本高效的强化学习，才能让真实机器人获得泛化能力。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robotics needs intrinsic rewards like model disagreement and dynamic, not quasi-static, policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实；真实机器人需要模型分歧等内在奖励，以及动态而非准静态的策略，才能完成接物等动态任务。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: robotics is a data problem, requiring diverse data sources, simulation, and real-world data to bridge the gap.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一条主线贯穿始终：机器人本质是数据问题，必须整合视频、仿真与真实世界数据，才能弥合泛化差距。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像 ChatGPT 之于语言那样的通用大脑，可驱动任何形态的机器人；预训练于多样数据、后训练于真实世界数据是关键配方。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，而非单纯商业问题；它无法像软件那样快速扩张，需要严格测试。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他主张即使对模型道德地位不确定，也应善待模型，因为成本低，且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating novel existence, not just human analogies; core identity with good traits, adaptable to roles.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型需要帮助应对其新颖存在，而非简单套用人类类比；模型应有核心身份与良好特质，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities; model welfare matters partly because it shapes future models' view of humanity.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了哲学理想与工程现实的平衡，并强调模型福祉重要，部分因为影响未来模型对人类看法。

askell.en: Claude's personality shaped by training data and fine-tuning, lacks real-world experience, childlike; transparency about AI values crucial.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，缺乏真实世界经验，具有孩童般特质；透明公开 AI 价值观至关重要。

askell.en: As models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他提出随着模型能力增强，应减少明确指导、给予更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳，削弱判断力。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer, and Scaling plus next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把神经网络视为简单数学表达式，却在难题优化中涌现意外行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，Scaling（规模扩张）与下一个词预测带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: The Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）主线：Transformer 带来干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃；认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory, LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology; we are in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存，LLM 是带人类心理特征的新操作系统；这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses; the cognitive core should be a stripped-down billion-parameter model.
karpathy.zh: 2025→26 年，他深化“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”的立场：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习很差，合成数据导致崩溃；认知核心应是剥离记忆的十亿参数模型。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed a line of code; the bottleneck is skill in directing agents; vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering preserves quality; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：自 12 月起不再手写代码，瓶颈是指导智能体的技能；氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住质量；可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors in driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型能实现推理和涌现式安全行为。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets are interpretable today with modern tools, contrary to past beliefs; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为，借助现代工具，端到端神经网络如今已可解释，而混合规则与学习系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; scaling current approaches solves driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前方法就能解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反思：基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；中短期内消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他主张：真正推动 AI 进步的是高质量数据与深度人工评估，而非可被刷分的基准；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and Elo leaderboards steers models toward slop; labs diverge by objective function.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他警告：为参与度和 Elo 排行榜优化会把模型引向垃圾内容；不同前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化。

edwinchen.en: Data quality requires taste and creativity; every company should eventually train its own models on its own thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他深化：数据质量需要品味与创造力；每家公司最终都应基于自身主张训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety trumps accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗：人类判断比以往更重要，安全优先于准确，而最大的风险可能是遗漏。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment and iterative deployment are pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展；随着系统变强，对齐与迭代部署愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计；能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于现实。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen even as timelines shorten; safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理考量。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就够了，专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability; long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；隐藏思维链才能保住可解释性价值；长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental, a hackathon demo; pricing was set via survey, not strategy.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，源于黑客松演示；定价靠问卷而非战略。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、高可供性产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve; unlimited plans may become unsustainable as technology changes.
turley.zh: 定价将演变；随着技术变化，无限套餐可能不可持续。

turley.en: Curiosity is the most important skill in the AI era to ask good questions.
turley.zh: 在 AI 时代，好奇心是提出好问题的最重要技能。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves, start simple, and build brand and culture before tackling complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司要先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂品类，同时把品牌与团队文化当作核心而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, using applied AI and content creation as leverage.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断长期做硬件公司很糟、利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，把面向消费者的应用型 AI 和内容创作当作杠杆。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a hype topic, with models commoditizing into a price war.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说大多数 AI 是胡扯、在解决不存在的问题；AI 应只是提升体验的原料，而非炒作话题，大模型正商品化并陷入价格战。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：智能手机交互将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，应用会消失，公司应开放 API。

carlpei.en: Design and marketing arbitrage are the fastest differentiators in mature categories; make tech fun to inspire creativity.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：在成熟品类里，设计与营销套利是最快的差异化手段，让科技重新有趣、激发人的创造力才是长期使命。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs toward AGI; learn from video, not just expensive RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具，认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张从视频而非昂贵强化学习中学习。

nando.en: Learning from video and few-shot prompting realize 'learning to learn'; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终相信从视频学习和少样本提示实现了“学会学习”，并坚持根本性创新可以来自任何地方，而不只是大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions, so alignment remains an open problem.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，并直言我们尚无解决方案，对齐仍是一个开放问题。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps; language models can revolutionize local-language education, and Africa has been influential in AI from the start.
nando.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，非洲跨越了遗留问题和性别差距，语言模型能革新本地语言教育，且非洲从一开始就对 AI 有影响力。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI; human skills like communication matter as much as coding; research requires embracing failure.
nando.zh: 贯穿始终的是：多样性与包容性对有益 AI 至关重要，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，研究需要拥抱失败。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data beyond the internet's tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而具身世界能提供互联网高质量 token 之外的无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Simple, elegant solutions scale, unlike complex modular academic approaches; building a demo is easy but a robust product for all use cases is exceptionally hard.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他强调简单优雅的方案才可扩展，反对学术界常见的复杂模块化路线；做出 demo 容易，但做成覆盖所有场景的稳健产品极难。

jimfan.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning via a simple end-to-end model.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题视为机器人学的核心瓶颈：真实数据稀缺昂贵，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是通过简单端到端模型扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is embodied AI's grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（低层控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分；让机器人打扫凌乱房间的物理图灵测试，才是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长程任务能力。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI，并把可靠性而非能力当作智能体的门槛。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; coding is the leading indicator, and long agentic coherence expands what models can build.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他深化为强化学习是与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；编程是进步领先指标，更长的智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能做的事。

sholto.en: Alignment is more promising than AI 2027 assumes; alignment faking and interpretability show models may strategically comply.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他对齐判断更乐观也更具体：对齐研究比 AI 2027 假设的更有希望，而对齐伪装与可解释性显示模型可能策略性顺从。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are off the AGI critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩下编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上，软件式奇点可能先于物理世界到来。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction misaligns with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必解决常识，下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones, so less compute may suffice.
yejin.zh: 推理期算法与高质量合成数据能让更小的模型追平大模型，因此更少算力也可能足够。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是插值人类知识而非超越它，因此 AI 必须探索未知知识。

yejin.en: RL requires careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and open research is vital against closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能让 pass@k 下降而 best-of-n 上升，开放研究对抗衡封闭前沿模型实验室至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 借助多样合成数据与多元对齐，小语言模型可超越大模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理增益。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉模式，把追求卓越的投入集中在有回报的地方。

henrymodisett.en: AI hardware will compete on design like radios did, commoditizing the underlying tech.
henrymodisett.zh: AI 硬件会像当年的收音机一样在设计上竞争，使底层技术商品化。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; ship fast, iterate, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与决断胜过完美；快速发布、持续迭代，让产品能力变强却不让人觉得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; brand narrative recruits talent, and designers need ownership, autonomy, and gut-led decisions.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；品牌叙事用于招募人才，设计师需要所有权、自主权，以及凭直觉做决定。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and design and engineering are merging.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，设计与工程正在融合。

nadchishtie.en: Treat quality like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 把质量视作债务：它会波动，需要与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Being too visionary and betting on future model capabilities can lead to failure.
nadchishtie.zh: 过于超前、押注未来模型能力可能导致失败。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行、并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

leike.en: AI safety needs more empirical researchers; alignment and robustness are under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全亟需更多实证研究者，对齐与鲁棒性研究不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken; post-training alone can't align AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现，仅靠后训练无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now, and uncertainty about alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 始终，他坚持对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，现在就能衡量进展，而对齐的不确定性是最大风险。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling 让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is a killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但 LLM 最好的应用往往出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而拖慢发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling 更高效。

shazeer.en: AI safety needs engineering safeguards and human oversight; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data.
shazeer.zh: AI 安全需要工程保障与人类监督；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and Reinforcement Learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快取代预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding, and frontier models struggle with bug finding due to missing training data and poor calibration.
truell.zh: 2024 年他强调基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型因缺乏训练数据、校准不佳而在找 bug 上表现挣扎。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他把编程的未来从写代码推进到更高层的意图表达，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment; the AI shift exceeds the internet and will unfold over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：自研定制模型成为每个惊艳体验的关键，这一转变比互联网更具颠覆性，并将持续数十年。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, while long-horizon reasoning still lacks hierarchical RL.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是主要路径，但长时程信用分配仍缺乏分层强化学习。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and pre-trained language models transfer reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并认为预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics targets 99.9% reliability; a single neural network generalizes across tasks and end effectors, showing generality is achievable in narrow domains.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出仓储机器人以 99.9%可靠性为价值门槛，单一神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化，说明通用性在窄领域内可实现。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hand-coded assumptions, and simulation or self-play as scalable learning signal.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移而非手工假设，仿真与自博弈是可扩展的学习信号。
